warnings: RESOLVES the T2 member sizes left null on หน้า16_view2 (S-03): T2 is a BOX-SECTION (RHS) truss, unlike T1 which is a channel/angle truss. Chords are เหล็กกล่อง 100x50x3.2, web members เหล็กกล่อง 75x45x3.2, purlins C125x50x20x3.2 @1.00 m. Span is dimensioned 6.00 m, matching the toilet block's grid 1-2 spacing exactly -- unlike T1, whose span is never dimensioned.

EAVE MEMBER -- this sheet's จุดต่อ 5 labels the อะเส 'อะเสเหล็ก 150x50x3.2 มม.' with a box symbol and three numbers. RESOLVED AGAINST this sheet on 2026-07-25: both S-03's หมายเหตุ and A-11's รูปตัด 1 (หน้า12) print it as the lipped channel C150x50x20x3.2, so two sheets to one. The box label here is treated as a drafting slip; the element above keeps the box form as printed for audit, but the canonical spec is the channel (see หน้า16_view2).

This sheet mixes both buildings: T2 / จุดต่อ 5 / Z-Z belong to the toilet block, while the ราวกันตก railing and its Y-Y section bolt to the MAIN building's B1 beam (WF150x150x7x10) along the front walkway. building is therefore null at the wrapper level.

RHS/box sections are recorded with designation 'RHS' and d/b/t keys. Spec §12 lists RHS as an unverified family -- this is the first real box section in the corpus and the key names are this file's proposal.

The railing's post spacing is only partly dimensioned: the sheet gives 'EQ. / 1.00 / EQ.' over a 3.40 m panel, so the two EQ. bays are 1.20 m each by arithmetic. That subtraction is NOT recorded as a dimension -- per spec §4 only printed dimensions are used, so post_spacing_note keeps the printed form and the flag records why.
The pipe railing is sized in INCHES (ø 2"), the only imperial dimension found anywhere in this drawing set. steel_section uses od_in rather than a millimetre key to avoid an unstated unit conversion.
